newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Trucks aims for U.S. break even.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Trucks aims for U.S. break even.

text.p: Volvo Trucks, the truck unit of Swedish automotive group AB Volvo, said on Wednesday it aims for break even levels for U.S. operations by mid-year.
"We will reach break even in our operations in North America at about mid-year this year," said Volvo Truck's managing director Karl-Erling Trogen.
"We reduced losses there already in the fourth quarter compared with the third last year."
Earlier Volvo Truck said its North American operations should break even in the first half of 1996.
But Trogen did not want to give any forecasts for the half year result in North America this year.
"Our orders in North America have started to get better this year than planned but I don't want to draw any conclusions from this."
He said in South America Volvo Trucks had already broken even.
"Really we are in the black in South America if you take into account that January is a holiday month there," he said.
